Important
Tracking from a local file:// address may be less reliable. Ad blockers and browser privacy settings can also block GA4. For reliable measurement, host this dashboard on an approved HTTPS location.
Privacy by design
The dashboard only sends generic usage events. It does not send LinkedIn post text, author names, LinkedIn URLs, uploaded images, search terms, internal titles, credentials or other personal data. Enable Analytics only after approval from the Sirius Medical privacy or compliance owner. Never store a service-account JSON file or API secret inside this HTML dashboard.

LinkedIn Score Model

Adjust how the AI Success Score is calculated. All LinkedIn posts and widgets update immediately.

Balanced Score Weights

Every metric is converted to a percentile against all current Sirius Medical LinkedIn posts before weighting.
Total: 100%

How the score works

  1. The dashboard calculates five metrics for every post.
  2. Each result is ranked against all current LinkedIn posts and converted into a 0–100 percentile.
  3. The percentiles are multiplied by the selected weights.
  4. The weighted results are added into one score from 0 to 100.

Interactions equals reactions + comments + reposts. Reach uses the imported reach value and falls back to impressions when reach is unavailable.

Changing a weight changes the current scoring model for every post. The underlying LinkedIn source metrics are never changed.

Import LinkedIn Dashboard Data

Import the original LinkedIn Excel export (.xls/.xlsx), CSV, or restore a complete dashboard backup from JSON.
1. Select file2. Map columns3. Preview4. Import result
Drop a LinkedIn Excel, CSV or dashboard JSON file here
or select a file below. LinkedIn .xls/.xlsx, CSV and JSON are supported. Excel exports are read directly.
Automatic LinkedIn mapping: Reach, reactions, comments, reposts, impressions, clicks, CTR and engagement are read from the export when available. Hashtags are automatically extracted from the post text, so a separate Hashtags column is not required. Dashboard-only fields such as Categories and Visual Tags remain optional.
Fields left as “Not mapped” will not be imported. For reliable updates, map LinkedIn URL or Post ID.
